lead_raw_text:
This structure of Li2Mg6 (reduced formula LiMg3) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Li and Mg centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each, at distances of about 3.10–3.13 Å; the neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Li- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
